clips.title: The story
paras: At the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch, Morgan the Collector directs Defias extortion and gathering across Elwynn Forest. A high-ranking operative, he coordinates local theft from the farmhouse while Goldshire's guard keeps watch nearby.

Morgan the Collector skims gold from Elwynn Forest's mines for the Defias Brotherhood. While common bandits harass travelers on the roads, he directs organized shakedowns and gathers stolen coin and supplies for the Brotherhood's wider network. His headquarters is the farmhouse at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch, where loyal enforcers including Surena Caledon and Erlan Drudgemoor surround him.
